QA-24283 is PASS with a data flag. Sum Engagements is 670, Pin Saves is "–" (counted as 0) and Comments is 670, so the assertion holds.

- **Default state:** Sephora has no Pinterest posts in the default week (Oct 12–18, 2026), nor from Sep 1 to Oct 18, 2026. I evaluated the assertion on Jun 11, 2024 – Jun 10, 2025 instead, which has 62,031 posts and is the same range QA-20334 used. The spec gives no date range, so this is my call.
- **Average row:** it shows 0 for Engagements and Comments, which is consistent with a per-post mean of about 0.01.
- **Per-row check:** Engagements = Pin Saves + Comments matched on all 200 rendered rows.
- **Data flag:** Pin Saves is "–" on every pin, as on QA-20334. The identity only holds because Engagements equals Comments. If Pinterest still supplies save counts, that is a collection gap, not a defect in the aggregate math.

Report: `results/2026-10-20/QA-24283-report.md`; screenshots are in `.playwright-out/QA-24283/`.
